svg.text: REFERENCE ONLY — a plate-bending model, not a measurement. Pinned supports, no contact, body plate only.
BODY PLATE UNDER A TOUCH PRESS — finite-element plate bending vs the strip model
5 lb at the screen edge, 162 mm from centre, delivered to the plate as a couple at the four VESA screws. Colour is deflection normal to the panel; red toward it, blue away. Same scale in every panel.
MAGNETS — 0.119 in (3.02 mm)
plate max |w| 0.021 mm · VESA rotation 0.32 mrad
screen edge moves 0.051 mm (strip model: 0.085 mm)
pinned on 8 fitted magnet discs O32 · 13261 elements
MAGNETS — 0.187 in (4.75 mm)
plate max |w| 0.006 mm · VESA rotation 0.08 mrad
screen edge moves 0.013 mm (strip model: 0.022 mm)
pinned on 8 fitted magnet discs O32 · 13261 elements
STRUTS — 0.119 in (3.02 mm)
plate max |w| 0.010 mm · VESA rotation 0.12 mrad
screen edge moves 0.020 mm
pinned on 4 elevator-bolt heads O30.2 · 13261 elements
STRUTS — 0.187 in (4.75 mm)
plate max |w| 0.003 mm · VESA rotation 0.03 mrad
screen edge moves 0.005 mm
pinned on 4 elevator-bolt heads O30.2 · 13261 elements
How to read it: the strip model is a magnet-wide cantilever and cannot see the holes; the plate model can, and is the more trustworthy of the two.
Both are elastic, small-deflection, no contact. A pinned magnet cannot lift off, so the pull-away column is optimistic there.
Below 0.2 mm at the screen edge reads as rigid to a finger (thickness_study.py).
